name: hound-jump
description: Counterplay run for the houndframe trial (?hound=1): identical to hound-grounded.json - same URL, same enemies, same 2.4s window, same terrain jump at the x=39 step - plus ONE jump at 1280ms, inside the first houndframe's telegraph and before it commits. 1280ms is the centre of the measured safe window (1230-1330ms at the current placements and camera scale); jumping later than that eats the charge, earlier eats it too. Everything else is held constant, so the hit-count difference isolates the charge.
